lock_mode_before_rebase.meaning: value of the lockMode field set by the onlyGuardian before rebaseOraclePack executes

lock_mode_after_rebase.meaning: value of the lockMode field after rebaseOraclePack executes

pool_exposed_for_continual_attack_occurr.meaning: the pool is exposed for continual attack that the onlyGuardian tried to prevent by setting lockMode to 3

assumptions: The lockMode value set by the onlyGuardian is 3 as stated in the report.
rebaseOraclePack execution is the checked transition between the before and after checkpoints.

unresolved.description: The report does not state the concrete post-rebase lockMode value or the exact mechanism by which rebaseOraclePack resets it; the correspondence is expressed symbolically between before and after checkpoints.

limitations: The impact is qualitative ('exposing the pool for continual attack'); it is represented as a grounded Boolean occurrence rather than a numeric magnitude.
The report does not state who may call rebaseOraclePack; caller authorization is not encoded in this claim.
